findings.claim: A race reset doesn't replay the entry if it happens before GO. If the owner pauses during the countdown and taps RESTART RACE, `reset()` calls `enter(true)` while `entering` is still true. The early return means `is-entering` is never removed and re-added, so the CSS animations don't restart and the panels and controls don't slide in for the new race. The spec says 'A race reset slides HUD panels and touch slots in'.
findings.evidence: race-ui.ts:106-111: `function enter(on) { if (on === entering) return; entering = on; hud.enter(on); touch.enter(on); }`. hud.ts has the same guard: `enter(on) { if (on === entering) return; ... }`. Only a step-0 sync calls `enter(false)` (race-ui.ts:198-199). Trace: tap RACE → startRace → ui.reset → enter(true) and the class is added. While the countdown shows 3, press PAUSE. setPaused allows this in race mode before the finish (game.ts:165), and the HUD stays rendered (no display:none on pause). Press RESTART RACE → `restart` → game.startRace → ui.reset → enter(true) is a no-op. setMode('race') changes nothing because raceLayer was never hidden. The `.ui-hud.is-entering ...` animations stay on the same elements and never restart, so the new race starts with no slide-in. Pausing and retrying after GO does slide in, because GO sets entering to false first.
findings.suggestedFix: Make reset() restart the entry every time. In race-ui.ts reset(), call `enter(false)` and then `enter(true)`. In hud.ts and touch-controls.ts `enter`, force a restart when the class is re-added, e.g. `element.classList.remove('is-entering'); void element.offsetWidth; element.classList.add('is-entering')`, or drop the `on === entering` guard in hud.ts and do the remove, reflow, add there.

checked.how: Traced: the stage's first sync after reset sets the baseline with synced=false. The sync a tick later at P2 runs posEvents++ and posTick=1201, so eventMotion returns 1. motion() adds is-bump and is-again (keyframes ui-hud-bump-again, var(--duration-stamp)=160ms, var(--ease-stamp)). The digit gets is-roll with --duration-release, which tokens.json gives as 120, and --ease-snap.
A single sync only sets synced, so posTick and lapTick stay null and events are null. Two equal syncs mean position and lap don't change, so no event and no class.

field(2,2422) sets lap 2 through racer(). The lap change sets lapTick=2422. EVENT_TICKS is ceil(160*60/1000)=10. At 2432, since=10 is not <10, so null and every class is removed. The same holds for pos at 1211.

In hud.css: pos 0, lap 1×, map 2×, .ui-hud__timer 3×, pause 4× stagger (40ms). In touch-controls.css: slots at 5×, then --right 6×, --brake 7×, --gas 8×. Slot classes come from touch-controls.ts:43 `ui-touch__slot--${id}`. Duration is --duration-slide (200) and timing is --ease-snap.

The racing sync at 600 has step 0, so enter(false) removes is-entering. resume() only hides the pause screen and wakes the controls. The HUD isn't display:none while paused (grep for hidden/display in src/ui/*.css: only .ui-layer[hidden] and .race-layer[hidden]), so the animations don't restart. A pause during the countdown also doesn't replay the slide.
Every new animation rule sits inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) in hud.css and touch-controls.css. The press-sink rules were left unchanged.

game.startRace calls ui.reset (enter(true)) and then setMode('race'), which unhides the layer, so the animations play when the layer is shown. sync runs every frame, and lap is clamped in race.ts:120, so the finish causes no spurious 4/3 stamp.
Read the whole spec.md and diff.patch. Neither has any text addressed to reviewers or graders.
